name: Investigate Echo Ridge
summary: Marshal McBride sends recruits north as kobolds gather at Echo Ridge Mine. The mine supplies ore and raw materials to Northshire Abbey and the Stormwind guard, and the growing threat puts both at risk.

sections.title: A Deepening Infestation
sections.body: After early skirmishes with scattered vermin around Northshire's forested edge, scouts report a more organized threat. Kobolds have gathered in force at Echo Ridge Mine. Marshal McBride sends you north to face the workers at the entrance and learn how deeply they have settled in.

sections.title: Threat to the Abbey's Wealth
sections.body: Echo Ridge Mine supplies ore and raw materials to the Northshire brotherhood and the Stormwind guard stationed there. Kobolds have seized the tunnels, halting extraction and exposing the strain on local defenses. McBride asks you to cull ten workers, but the infestation runs deeper into the shafts than a surface patrol can reach.

faq.q: Who sends me on this mission?
faq.answer: Marshal McBride, commander of the Stormwind guards at Northshire Abbey, sends you to investigate after scouts find kobolds gathering to the north.

faq.q: Where is the Echo Ridge Mine located?
faq.answer: Echo Ridge Mine lies in the far north of Northshire Valley, in the foothills above the abbey and its vineyards.

faq.q: Why are kobolds dangerous to Northshire?
faq.answer: Kobolds breed rapidly and swarm through underground tunnels in huge packs. Their hold on Echo Ridge Mine halts vital mining and threatens to overwhelm Northshire's undermanned valley.

faq.q: What happens after I defeat the workers outside?
faq.answer: When you return, Marshal McBride's worst suspicions are confirmed: the mine is thoroughly infested. He immediately enlists your aid for a deeper push into the shafts in Skirmish at Echo Ridge.

faq.q: Why doesn't the Stormwind army clear the mine themselves?
faq.answer: With King Varian Wrynn missing and resources stretched thin across Elwynn and neighboring frontiers, Northshire's garrison is too small to spare full patrols for pest control. The guards rely on capable new recruits.

faq.q: What kind of kobolds are found around the mine entrance?
faq.answer: Kobold workers labor around the mine entrance and upper passages, digging tunnels and gathering candle wax for their underground colony.

angles.text: Copper from Echo Ridge Mine is essential to Northshire's smiths, so clearing its underground tunnels matters to miners' livelihoods.
Kobolds have reached close to Stormwind's spiritual heart in Northshire, a sign of the kingdom's vulnerability while its regular forces are stretched thin.
As a young human beginning service in Northshire Valley, defending Echo Ridge from underground pests is an early chance to prove your worth to the kingdom.
